svg.title: Ministry of Energy, Mines and Low Carbon Innovation
svg.desc: Clean reconstruction using shared native primitives and explicit smooth geometry; no photograph contour tracing. The shared sun and British Columbia wordmark are native PofBC paths. Ministry names are newly typeset with an outlined serif substitute; exact font metrics remain approximate.
